elicitation_input.question: Design an algorithm of hypertension drugs to help the clinician make the best medication choice according to the patient and their health characteristics.
elicitation_input.question_type: Summarization of information on a topic

llm_generation.text:
# Hypertension Treatment Algorithm

## Step 1: Confirm Diagnosis & Risk Stratification

**BP Thresholds (ACC/AHA 2017 / ESC 2018):**
- Elevated: 120-129/<80
- Stage 1: 130-139/80-89
- Stage 2: ≥140/90

**Before drug selection, assess:**
- ASCVD risk score (10-year)
- Target organ damage (LVH, CKD, retinopathy)
- Comorbidities (diabetes, CAD, HF, CKD, stroke history)
- Race/ethnicity (Black patients often respond better to CCBs/thiazides)
- Age
- Pregnancy status

---

## Step 2: Compelling Indications (Comorbidity-Driven Selection)

| Condition | First-Line Choice | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| **Heart Failure (HFrEF)** | ACEi/ARB/ARNI + Beta-blocker (carvedilol, metoprolol succinate, bisoprolol) + MRA (spironolactone) + SGLT2i | GDMT — mortality benefit |
| **Post-MI / CAD** | Beta-blocker + ACEi | Reduces remodeling, mortality |
| **CKD (proteinuric)** | ACEi or ARB | Renoprotective, reduces proteinuria |
| **Diabetes** | ACEi/ARB | Renal protection |
| **Atrial fibrillation** | Beta-blocker or non-DHP CCB (diltiazem/verapamil) | Rate control + BP |
| **Isolated Systolic HTN (elderly)** | CCB (dihydropyridine) or thiazide | Best evidence (SHEP, HYVET) |
| **Pregnancy** | Labetalol, Nifedipine, Methyldopa | Safety (avoid ACEi/ARB — teratogenic) |
| **BPH** | Alpha-blocker (as add-on, not monotherapy) | Dual benefit |
| **Osteoporosis** | Thiazide | Reduces calcium excretion |
| **Migraine** | Beta-blocker (propranolol) or CCB | Prophylaxis overlap |
| **Recurrent stroke prevention** | ACEi + thiazide | PROGRESS trial data |

---

## Step 3: No Compelling Indication — General Algorithm

```
                    STAGE 1-2 HTN, no compelling indication
                                    |
              ┌─────────────────────┴─────────────────────┐
        Black patient                              Non-Black patient
              |                                            |
    Thiazide-like diuretic                    ACEi, ARB, CCB, or Thiazide
    (chlorthalidone) OR CCB                    (any as first-line)
    (amlodipine)                                          |
              |                                            |
              └─────────────────────┬──────────────────────┘
                                     |
                    BP not at goal after 1 month at max dose
                                     |
                    Add SEC
```
